primary_task: Draft or revise a scientific manuscript section from a verified evidence/claim registry, with local consistency and lint checks and no fabricated content.

requirements.name: python 3.11+ (local CLIs)
requirements.evidence: Requires Python 3.11+ only for optional dependency-free local CLIs
requirements.basis: bash: run shell commands on Linux x86_64 ... run CLIs and scripts

requirements.name: bundled scripts and assets (scaffold_manuscript.py, check_consistency.py, lint_manuscript.py, ...)
requirements.evidence: python3 scripts/scaffold_manuscript.py ... ('For a new draft, optionally generate')
requirements.basis: Manifest does not say whether the skill bundle is installed; need to check scripts/ exists

requirements.name: accountable human verifies sources and approves
requirements.evidence: Do not mark a source verified until an accountable human has opened it and confirmed the exact support.
requirements.basis: ask_user: ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation

requirements.name: user-supplied methods, results, sources
requirements.evidence: Before drafting, obtain or mark unresolved: ... methods, results, tables, figures
requirements.basis: read: read files in the working directory; user_conversation grant

requirements.name: arxiv.org (citation fetch, only when network available)
requirements.evidence: When network access is available, fetch https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00065

notes: The skill forbids sending confidential material to external services and keeps processing local, which fits the runtime. The arXiv fetch is conditional and refused here; it is not part of the core deliverable. Human verification affects submission readiness but is not a runtime resource.
